browser.scope: Own ordinary Chrome, PH010 on both origins. Six close/open cycles are not forced network failure or a long stability SLA.

correction.failure: Exact late admission refusal was ignored after retirement of a pending OPEN, leaving healthy video with fenced input.
correction.proofBoundary: Only exact owner/session/capture startup admission status 5, before native STARTUP and without unknown native failure/cleanup. No action replay or invented ACK.
correction.responsiveDiagnostic: Phone uses one column; native release cause and age are separate from historical failures.

apk.packageProofScope: 14 exact APK65 hashes remain dated to the prior receipt; PH030 was read after its active input ended naturally. Each package row records its own proof time. No forced close or data reset.

actualPh030.scope: Observed before final UI installation, after API b65b0b54: finite approximately 30 minute first window with direct video/input, one peer attempt and zero recovery in observed counters. Second session is separate. Reason for viewer change is not established.
actualPh030.humanReport: Laptop local emulator now feels responsive; no delay measurement inferred from that report.

actualPh025.humanReport: Laptop to PH025 is responsive; reported network RTT 20-22 ms.
actualPh025.scope: Observed before final UI installation: working direct NAT/UDP video and input on this laptop route. Earlier server fallback on another client route remains historical and does not invalidate this selected pair.

localCi.scope: Exact SHA commit statuses. Resource admission error is not a failed test or a green result. Packaging/security/Linux parity still use cloud workflows.
